text: かぜは　ぼくの　ほうに　ふいて　いる！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on right now. ふいて　いる = 'is blowing'.

patterns.name: 〜のほうに
patterns.explanation: のほうに after a person or thing says something moves in that direction, toward that side. ぼくの　ほうに = 'my way, toward me'.
